designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1936, with the primary purpose of preserving and enhancing resting, feeding, and breeding habitat for migratory birds and other wildlife, this 15,551-acre refuge contains numerous wetlands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
